info.title: Tubbataha Reefs
info.description: A 97,030-hectare marine sanctuary in Palawan and is located at the core of the Coral Triangle. The reefs are crucial for distributing coral and fish larvae in the Sulu Sea.

problems.title: Illegal Fishing
problems.description: A perennial concern as fish productiivty dwindles

problems.title: Marine Debris
problems.description: Plastic manufactured in other countries such as Malaysia, Indonesia, and Vietnam.

problems.title: Climate Change
problems.description: Extreme temperatures caused by climate change resulted in coral bleaching, which affected up to 20% of the hard coral cover of the park in 2020.

solutions.title: The Tubbataha Act
solutions.description: Provides the legal and institutional framework for enforcement in the Tubbataha Reefs.

solutions.title: Beach Reforestation
solutions.description: The Cagayancillo Women for Tubbataha to grow saplings of beach forest trees in an effort to replenish tree populations on the islets of Tubbataha.
